text.arabic_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ سَرَبًۭا

words.gloss_range: sequential connector opening the ayah as continuation from the prior vow
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes 18:61 begin as the next movement after the declaration in 18:60. It binds the ayah to the realized-time frame that follows, so the arrival is heard as enacted continuation rather than a detached report; its light sound also gives a quick pickup into the heavier temporal opener.

topics.headline: ayah opens as sequel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:61 grammatically carries the pursuit announced in 18:60 into the arrival scene.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence identify the word as a conjunction before the temporal frame, and the CRITICAL rows coherently read it as immediate narrative continuation.

topics.headline: connector fused to time frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector and the temporal opener as one launch unit, not as a loose new paragraph.
topics.reason: The cliticized surface and opening position support the CRITICAL claim that the particle is formally tied to the following temporal particle.

words.gloss_range: realized temporal when-clause, not negation; locally frames completed arrival and expects a response
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, nearness, and temporal convergence as background pressure; the local function remains the temporal particle
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَّا}} ({{tr:lammā}}) frames the arrival as a realized condition and makes the following forgetting the syntactic answer. Its bound, doubled form gives that arrival frame a compact recited weight. Its root-family pressure of gathering and nearness matters because it stands beside the junction word: time converges as place converges. The recurrence of the same temporal opener in 18:62 also makes this episode move by realized scene beats.

topics.headline: realized when-clause governs the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrival is only the setup; the grammatical payoff of the time clause is the forgetting.
topics.reason: The particle governs a past verb in the temporal clause, and attachment evidence identifies the following forgetting clause as the sequenced event.

topics.headline: time and place converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the temporal threshold as a gathered moment that matches the physical junction, while still reading the word as a temporal particle.
topics.reason: The local grammar selects the temporal particle; the gathering-nearness root pressure survives only as image because the adjacent destination is a convergence place.

topics.headline: repeated opener segments the episode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the journey divided into scene beats, with this opener answered by another one in 18:62.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence at 18:62 supports the CRITICAL claim that the particle functions as a local narrative hinge.

topics.headline: weighted temporal launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact but weighty entry into the arrival frame.
topics.reason: The bound opening form and doubled consonant support a modest recitational payoff without changing the syntax.

words.gloss_range: they two reached; completed arrival at the named destination, with threshold and fulfillment pressure
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, attaining a limit, and delivery/communication; local grammar selects physical arrival while keeping fulfillment pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَغَا}} ({{tr:balaghā}}) turns the prior goal of 18:60 into completed arrival by a dual pair. The verb reaches a direct destination, so the scene is not merely travel near a place; it is arrival at the junction. Its root range also lets the arrival feel like a threshold and a fulfilled declaration, while the contrast with singular reaching in 18:86 keeps companionship visible here.

topics.headline: vow becomes completed arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from the intended reaching in 18:60 to completed dual reaching in 18:61.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect dual and continues the two travelers from 18:60, matching the CRITICAL vow-to-fulfillment reading.

topics.headline: destination is syntactically reached
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the junction as the attained object of the verb, not as incidental scenery.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَجْمَعَ}} ({{tr:majmaʿa}}) as the direct object of the reaching verb.

topics.headline: arrival carries threshold pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels arrival as a limit crossed and a declaration delivered into event, while the local sense remains physical reaching.
topics.reason: The broader root range supports threshold and delivery pressure, but the local object and clause frame select arrival at a destination.

topics.headline: dual reaching contrasts singular authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this arrival is grammatically companioned, unlike the singular reaching scene in 18:86.
topics.reason: The same-surah comparison is a contrast in number and narrative role, not a change to the local parse.

words.gloss_range: junction or convergence-place reached as the verb's object and specified by the following between-phrase
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, joining, and resolve; local form is a place/time noun for convergence, with variant pressure toward instrumentality
words.prose: {{ar:مَجْمَعَ}} ({{tr:majmaʿa}}) is the reached destination, and its construct relation to the next word makes the junction specific without needing an article. The derived place form turns gathering into geography: this is the point where the prior goal in 18:60 becomes a functional threshold, and the next clause turns achieved arrival into the setting for loss. The variant pressure toward an instrument of gathering is useful as apparatus, but the local received form remains the convergence-place.

topics.headline: junction is the attained object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the junction as a syntactically reached and specified destination.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as object of the reaching verb and governs the following between-phrase as specification.

topics.headline: place named by gathering function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is not a neutral landmark but a place defined by convergence.
topics.reason: QAC marks a noun of time/place, and the root/form evidence supports the CRITICAL reading of a functionally named convergence site.

topics.headline: goal word returns at fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the destination word return from 18:60, so success at reaching becomes the setting for loss.
topics.reason: The word reprises the stated goal from 18:60 and is tightly episode-bound in the supplied recurrence evidence.

topics.headline: variant hears a gathering-device
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note an apparatus-level variant that makes the junction feel instrumental, while the local surface remains the place of convergence.
topics.reason: The variant is useful for semantic pressure, but it does not replace the aligned local form as a place/time noun.

words.gloss_range: between them; a singular interval with a dual suffix, most locally referring back to the two seas while preserving compact ambiguity
words.root_gloss_range: between, separation, relation, and clarification; local use holds distinction and connection together
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنِهِمَا}} ({{tr:baynihumā}}) supplies the junction's specifying interval. The dual suffix reaches back across 18:60, most strongly to the two seas, while the grammar also keeps the two travelers audible. The word's root pressure is especially apt: the place is a between-space that separates and connects at once, and its closing position leaves the arrival beat on a liminal boundary before forgetting begins. That same dual-suffix sound will echo in the fish phrase, linking the between-space to the possessed fish before the fish departs.

topics.headline: junction specified as interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination is defined by a relation between two entities, not by a place-name alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the word the specifying complement of the junction noun.

topics.headline: dual suffix carries a compact antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pronoun compress the prior pair from 18:60, with context favoring the two seas while leaving the traveler pair resonant.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence privileges the prior sea-pair for the suffix, but the dual traveler frame explains why the ambiguity remains felt.

topics.headline: between-space both divides and joins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the junction as a boundary that only works because distinction and contact remain simultaneous.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports both interval and relational linkage, and the local junction phrase requires both.

topics.headline: arrival beat closes on the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the arrival frame end on a dual-suffix boundary that will echo in the fish phrase.
topics.reason: The word's position and repeated dual suffix are locally visible and connect the interval to the next possessed noun.

words.gloss_range: they two forgot or left behind; locally a perfect dual verb with an explicit fish object and jawāb function
words.root_gloss_range: forgetting, neglecting, and leaving behind; local grammar states the travelers' lapse before later reports complicate agency
words.prose: {{ar:نَسِيَا}} ({{tr:nasiyā}}) is the answer to the temporal frame: when they reached, they forgot. The dual verb keeps both travelers inside the narrator's first account, and the explicit object prevents the lapse from becoming vague. Its range includes forgetting and leaving behind, which suits the scene because the fish is lost from human attention and then moves on its own; 18:63 will retell the same lapse as singular confession and caused forgetting.

topics.headline: forgetting answers arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the narrative payoff of reaching the junction is not discovery but forgetting.
topics.reason: The verb functions as the response to the temporal clause and is placed immediately after the arrival frame.

topics.headline: shared lapse has a specific object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees both travelers held in the lapse and sees the fish as the specific thing forgotten.
topics.reason: The verb has dual subject agreement and takes the possessed fish as explicit direct object.

topics.headline: forgetting also feels like leaving behind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hold cognitive lapse and functional abandonment together without making the text choose only one.
topics.reason: The local grammar states forgetting of an object; the semantic range adds leaving-behind pressure because the fish then departs.

topics.headline: later retelling shifts responsibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:61 gives the narrator's dual baseline before 18:63 shifts to singular confession and external causation.
topics.reason: The same root recurs in 18:63 with changed number and agency, supporting a local echo rather than changing the present verb's parse.

words.gloss_range: their fish; a concrete possessed object of forgetting that becomes the next clause's implicit actor
words.root_gloss_range: large aquatic creature, with enclosing/surrounding pressure in the root family; locally concrete fish/provision and imminent agent
words.prose: {{ar:حُوتَهُمَا}} ({{tr:ḥūtahumā}}) is first grammatically theirs: a singular fish possessed by the two travelers and object of their forgetting. That same noun is positioned to become the hidden subject of the next verb, so a possessed object flips into an autonomous agent. The fish is concrete and aquatic, fitting the sea-return; in 18:63 it returns as a definite fish with ownership stripped away. Its comparison with Yūnus's fish scenes (37:142; 68:48) sharpens the reversal, since here the fish escapes possession rather than containing a prophet.

topics.headline: their fish is the named loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fish introduced under dual human possession as the precise object of the lapse.
topics.reason: The suffix refers to the traveler pair and the noun is the direct object of the forgetting verb.

topics.headline: provision becomes sea-creature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owned travel provision is also a creature naturally suited to the sea it enters.
topics.reason: The local surface names a concrete fish; provision and enclosing-root pressures are retained as scene color, not as replacements for that referent.

topics.headline: object becomes actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the fish as the hinge between human forgetting and non-human agency.
topics.reason: The next verb's masculine singular subject is resolved to the fish, so the prior object becomes the following actor.

topics.headline: ownership dissolves in retelling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fish move from possessed item in 18:61 to more independent definite referent in 18:63, with a broader prophetic-fish contrast in 37:142 and 68:48.
topics.reason: The same fish lexeme returns in 18:63 with ownership removed, and the supplied comparison to Yūnus scenes supports a controlled reversal contrast.

words.gloss_range: immediate consequence connector from the forgetting clause to the fish's action
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the fish's action the immediate consequence of the forgetting. It separates the two perfect verbs while binding them in sequence: the humans fail to retain the fish, so the fish takes its path. Its fusion into the following verb makes the consequence audible and visible at the start of the escape clause.

topics.headline: forgetting yields fish action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the escape is not a remote next event but the grammatically marked consequence of forgetting.
topics.reason: Clause evidence identifies the following verbal clause as sequenced after the forgetting, matching the CRITICAL taʿqīb and causal payoff.

topics.headline: connector welded to action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pivot from human lapse into fish agency as a single forward movement.
topics.reason: The clitic connector is formally attached to the following verb and marks the internal hinge of the ayah.

words.gloss_range: it took/adopted for itself; Form VIII perfect with the fish as hidden singular subject
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, adopting, and choosing; local Form VIII makes the taking self-directed and path-focused
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذَ}} ({{tr:ittakhadha}}) gives the fish completed singular agency after the dual human lapse. The hidden subject is recovered from the fish, and Form VIII makes the taking self-directed: the fish takes its own path, not merely undergoes motion. A variant can make the path-taking part of what was forgotten, but the local finite verb preserves independent fish action. The familiar path-taking formula returns in 18:63, while the later ship-taking scene in 18:79 shows how different this instance is: here taking belongs to a fish and its way, not a ruler and other people's vessels.

topics.headline: fish silently becomes subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the previous forgotten object becoming the completed singular actor.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the 3ms subject to the immediately preceding fish.

topics.headline: taking is self-directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices deliberate self-routing in the verb form, rather than simple passive disappearance.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form VIII, and the CRITICAL rows coherently read the derived form as reflexive or self-directed taking.

topics.headline: familiar formula assigned to non-human agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognized path-taking formula made strange by its fish subject and confirmed again in 18:63.
topics.reason: The verb-plus-path phrase repeats in 18:63 and belongs to a broader taking-path field, but the local subject specializes it.

topics.headline: finite verb resists nominal absorption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can note the variant possibility of making path-taking part of what was forgotten, while the local finite verb preserves independent fish action.
topics.reason: The local aligned form is finite perfect; the variant provides contrast but does not govern the received parse.

topics.headline: fish taking contrasts royal taking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes this self-routing fish action from the later sea-and-ships taking scene in 18:79.
topics.reason: Same-surah taking language supports a contrast between non-human self-routing here and human seizure in 18:79.

words.gloss_range: its path or way; direct object of the fish's self-directed taking, with suffix referring to the fish
words.root_gloss_range: road, path, means, course, and flow/descent imagery; local use is a concrete sea-route carrying broader way-language
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلَهُ}} ({{tr:sabīlahu}}) makes the fish's route possessed by the fish itself. The hidden subject of the verb and the suffix point to the same creature, so the clause becomes self-routing in content. The word keeps the broad register of way or course, but the sea phrase makes it a concrete path into water; its exact return in 18:63 keeps the fish's path stable across narrator and youth accounts. Its sibilant path-sound also threads forward into the final passage-word.

topics.headline: the fish takes its own path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ownership shift from the travelers' fish to the fish's own route.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the suffix to the fish, not to the travelers, and the word is the object of the taking verb.

topics.headline: way-language becomes sea-course
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels broader way-language and flow imagery carried into a concrete aquatic route.
topics.reason: The sea context narrows the word to the fish's physical course while allowing broader way and flow pressure to remain active.

topics.headline: formula focused by suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognized take-a-path formula made specific by the fish's possessive suffix.
topics.reason: The supplied collocation evidence supports the formula, and the local suffix prevents generic path language.

topics.headline: path phrase returns and threads into closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the possessed path phrase return in 18:63 and link forward to the closing passage-word.
topics.reason: The phrase repeats in 18:63, and the local sound/structure rows connect it to the final passage description.

words.gloss_range: in or into; preposition making the sea the containing medium/domain of the path
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the path-taking into movement inside the sea-domain. With a motion verb it can carry entry force, but it still preserves containment: the sea is not merely an endpoint reached from outside but the medium within which the path runs. Its position after the path foregrounds the route first and then names the domain it enters.

topics.headline: path enters a containing medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fish's route is taken into and within the sea, not merely toward it.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the sea noun as complement to the path-taking clause and supports containment with directional entry.

topics.headline: route before domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the possessed path named first, then guided into its medium.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the path object and remains a separate word, preserving a distinct medium boundary.

words.gloss_range: the sea; definite singular governed by the preposition as the fish's path-medium
words.root_gloss_range: sea, vast expanse, and opening/splitting pressure; local sense is the sea as focused passage-medium
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرِ}} ({{tr:al-baḥri}}) is governed by the preposition, so the sea is the medium of the fish's route, not the object taken. Its definite singular form is loaded by 18:60's two-sea frame: at the junction of two seas, the fish enters the sea as one focused domain. The sea's vastness and opening pressure meet the final passage word, and the broader surah contrast with taking ships at sea in 18:79 keeps this fish-route distinct from human control over the maritime scene.

topics.headline: sea is medium, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the sea as the domain through which the path moves, while the path remains the object taken.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and is not the direct object of the taking verb.

topics.headline: two-sea frame narrows to one sea-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from the two seas in 18:60 to the singular definite sea entered by the fish in 18:61.
topics.reason: The form is definite singular, while the prior frame supplies the dual sea antecedent.

topics.headline: vast sea opens into passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sea not just as setting but as the vast material through which the passage forms.
topics.reason: The local sense remains sea, but the root and adjacency to the final passage word support opening and vastness pressure.

topics.headline: fish-route contrasts ship-taking scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this sea entry inside the surah's maritime network while distinguishing it from the ship-taking scene in 18:79.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence supports maritime linkage; the local clause keeps this instance as fish self-routing rather than human seizure.

words.gloss_range: as a passage, tunneling, or by slipping away; final accusative manner/result word
words.root_gloss_range: tunnel, passage, flow, free-going movement, and mirage-related elusiveness; local sense is real passage with vanishing pressure
words.prose: {{ar:سَرَبًۭا}} ({{tr:saraban}}) lands the ayah on the manner or result of the fish's path. As an accusative, it can describe the fish moving tunneling or the path becoming a tunnel-like passage; either way, the final word makes the route part of the action's grammar. The root range holds real passage, flow, free-going release, and mirage-like elusiveness together, so the fish's path is concrete enough to be taken and elusive enough to vanish from human control. In 18:63 the same event is retold as wonder, so the narrator's mechanism-word becomes the youth's astonishment. The long pursuit therefore closes on a sudden passage that trails away rather than on a bounded destination.

topics.headline: final accusative makes passage grammatical
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing word as part of the verb's action, either its manner or its made result.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the word as circumstantial manner or second object, preserving the CRITICAL parse ambiguity.

topics.headline: passage is tunnel, flow, and release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the fish's route as a real passage through water and as released movement into its proper medium.
topics.reason: The local sea context strongly licenses passage and flow senses, and the final position lets those senses close the ayah.

topics.headline: real passage shadowed by mirage field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the local path real while feeling the root's rare vanishing-water field around it.
topics.reason: The local form means passage, not mirage; rarity and mirage-family evidence survive as elusiveness pressure.

topics.headline: mechanism becomes wonder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the narrator's objective passage-word in 18:61 from the youth's wondrous reaction in 18:63.
topics.reason: The same event is described with different final words in 18:61 and 18:63, supporting the objective-description versus subjective-reaction contrast.

topics.headline: ayah closes on trailing passage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the long pursuit invert into a sudden passage that trails away at the ayah's end.
topics.reason: The word is final and indefinite accusative, and the sound/structure rows coherently make the closure feel unbounded and resonant.

baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching, gathering, and being between combine into a threshold that joins two sides without cancelling their interval. The place is a relation in tension, not merely a point on a route.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a terminus supplies the threshold event.
Joining dispersed elements makes the site a confluence.
The interval between two sides keeps separation active inside the confluence.

changed_reading.before: The pair arrives at a meeting-place.
changed_reading.after: The pair enters an interstitial threshold where conjunction and separation remain simultaneously active.

baseline_models.mechanism: Dual neglect removes the fish from shared custody, while the next singular verb makes that possessed object the agent that adopts a route of its own.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or neglecting the fish withdraws the pair's active custody.
The literal fish supplies the possessed object that becomes the next clause's agent.
Adopting or acquiring gives the fish self-directed initiative through its route.

changed_reading.before: They accidentally leave their fish and it escapes.
changed_reading.after: Shared neglect transfers initiative: what was grammatically theirs becomes an agent that appropriates a way of its own.

baseline_models.mechanism: The extended road-image gives direction, while the two live sarb branches render that direction as a concealed conduit poised between a descending tunnel and seepage.

activation_trace.role: A traversable extended road gives the movement directional form.
Abundant open water supplies the medium through which the route appears.
A descending tunnel or burrow gives the route hidden depth.
Flowing and seepage keep a second material image of a channel formed in water.

changed_reading.before: The fish swims away in the sea.
changed_reading.after: The fish's way is rendered as a concealed, conduit-like passage through the sea, materially ambiguous between tunnel and seepage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The declared refusal to depart until the confluence is reached is followed by actual passage beyond it and fatigue. The focus arrival is objectively true but experientially unregistered; forgetting the fish removes the recognition signal.

activation_trace.role: Remaining under negation establishes persistence until the stated goal.
Reaching a terminus defines the confluence as the stopping condition.
Loss of active remembrance supplies the failure to register the reached threshold.
Cutting through and passing a place locates the pair beyond the focus threshold.
Weariness supplies delayed bodily evidence that travel continued too far.

structural_cues: 18:60 makes reaching the confluence the stopping condition; 18:61 marks arrival; 18:62 begins after they have passed beyond it.
Fatigue is named only after the overshoot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: stopping vow, arrival, forgetting, overshoot, and fatigue. Reader arrow: forgetting blocks recognition, so fatigue becomes delayed evidence of excess travel. Live alternative: they recognized the focus point and simply resumed travel.

changed_reading.before: The focus records a recognized arrival followed by an unrelated lapse.
changed_reading.after: The focus records arrival without recognition: the sought threshold is crossed precisely because its embodied sign is forgotten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus dual compresses a group failure that 18:63 unpacks as one participant's forgetting of the fish and causative forgetting of recalling or reporting it. Shared possession and onward movement let a local lapse become the pair's failure.

activation_trace.role: The dual loss of remembrance states the failure at pair level.
Forgetting and being made to forget unpack the lapse around one speaker.
Recovery after forgetting identifies the missing act as active recollection or report.

structural_cues: 18:61 uses dual نَسِيَا; 18:63 uses singular نَسِيتُ and causative أَنسَىٰنِيهُ.
The fish remains dual-possessed even when the later explanation localizes the lapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: dual attribution followed by a singular and causative account. Reader arrow: this is distributed responsibility rather than necessarily identical cognition in both travelers. Live alternative: both forgot independently, while 18:63 explains only one member's part.

changed_reading.before: Both travelers undergo the same private memory lapse.
changed_reading.after: The dual verb can register a shared operational failure whose cognitive lapse and failure to report are localized in one member.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once remembered, the fish's divergent sea-passage locates the missed station; return, remaining traces, and track-following invert the human route. The fish's path is not itself retraced, but it functions as a counter-trace that makes their own path retraceable.

activation_trace.role: The hidden descending passage supplies a route that diverges from the travelers' visible route.
Recovered remembrance reactivates the escaped route as location-bearing information.
Return to a prior place reverses the direction established by the overshoot.
A remaining mark makes the travelers' earlier movement recoverable.
Following a trace supplies the procedure for navigating backward.

structural_cues: 18:63 repeats the fish's sea-route at the moment of recollection.
18:64 immediately joins return with their traces and deliberate track-following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: remembered fish-route followed by return on human traces. Reader arrow: the anomalous escape indexes the missed station and converts loss into navigation. Live alternative: only the remembered rock, not the path-image, locates the return point.

changed_reading.before: The fish's route records only its disappearance.
changed_reading.after: Its remembered divergence becomes a negative waymark: the route that cannot be followed identifies where the human route must be reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus juxtaposes the pair's forgetting with the fish's taking or adopting its route; 18:73 recombines the same roots as a request not to be taken to account for forgetting. The agency transfer acquires an accountability shadow.

activation_trace.role: Neglect supplies the human relinquishment side of the focus sequence.
Adopting a route supplies the fish's active taking after human neglect.
Taking someone to account for fault converts the repeated root into explicit liability.
The repeated forgetting names the fault for which accountability is refused.
Imposing a heavy burden supplies the consequence attached to being taken to account.

structural_cues: 18:61 orders نسي then اتخذ; 18:73 places تؤاخذني directly against بما نسيت.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same forgetting and taking roots recur in a compact accountability construction. Reader arrow: the later clause activates a juridical echo in the focus agency shift. Live alternative: these are common roots recurring without a designed echo.

changed_reading.before: The fish's taking only contrasts active animal movement with human inattention.
changed_reading.after: The sequence also carries an accountability pattern: neglect relinquishes control, while later forgetting is something for which a person may be taken to task.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places an interval or connection inside gathering; 18:78 places two instances of between inside explicit parting. The same relational space can therefore host conjunction or separation, so reaching the meeting-place does not resolve relational tension.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed sides supplies the conjunction pole.
A connection standing between parties keeps relation active within the meeting-place.
Distinguishing and separating two parties supplies the explicit parting pole.
The repeated between-phrases activate the root's separation branch inside the declaration of parting.

structural_cues: 18:61 compounds gathering with between; 18:78 compounds parting with two between-phrases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a lexical opposition between مجمع بينهما and فراق بيني وبينك. Reader arrow: the later formula reactivates the focus as an ambivalent relational frame. Live alternative: each use of بين is only locally compositional.

changed_reading.before: The confluence is a stable geographical union.
changed_reading.after: The confluence is an ambivalent between-space: the grammar that joins sides already preserves the interval from which parting can emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet closes with another dual reaching: two orphans reach full strength so their concealed treasure can be extracted. This reverses the focus's dual reaching, where the pair's possessed fish passes into concealment. A threshold can release an object away from or toward its dual holders.

activation_trace.role: The pair's arrival at a terminus supplies the opening dual-reaching frame.
Their fish supplies the possessed object released away from the dual holders.
Stored wealth supplies the concealed possessed object preserved for the closing pair.
The orphans' arrival at a terminus repeats the dual-reaching frame.
Reaching full strength specifies the later threshold as maturation.
Bringing a thing out of concealment reverses the fish's movement into hidden passage.

structural_cues: 18:61 has dual بَلَغَا, dual possession in حُوتَهُمَا, and movement into a tunnel-like way.
18:82 has dual يَبْلُغَا, dual possession in كَنزَهُمَا, and extraction from beneath a wall.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated dual reaching plus oppositely directed possessed objects. Reader arrow: the two scenes form loss and protected-recovery poles of a threshold pattern. Live alternative: the repeated reaching language marks endpoints without linking the objects.

changed_reading.before: The focus loss is a local mishap at one reached place.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes the loss pole of a larger dual-reaching reversal: one threshold releases a possession into concealment, while the later threshold releases a concealed possession to its holders.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it gives an animal escape political valence and uses the form-distant fish-evasion branch. It remains anchored because the focus and 18:79 repeat ء خ ذ in the same sea domain while 18:79 specifies coercive seizure. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory contrast, not an intentional allegory or a claim about the fish's motive.

activation_trace.role: Fish-like evasive maneuvering supplies the exploratory mode of escape.
Adopting a route supplies self-directed taking rather than being taken.
The extended traversable road gives evasion a concrete route.
The repeated broad-water setting keeps the contrast in one marine domain.
Capture and seizure turn the later taking into coercive possession.
Taking property by force makes coercion explicit and sharpens the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The fish simply escapes into the sea.
changed_reading.after: Its self-taken route can be carried as an evasive counter-form to the later king's coercive taking of sea-going property: taking a way prevents being taken.

strongest_changes: Arrival becomes a threshold recognized only after it has been overshot.
Dual forgetting resolves into distributed group failure, then the escaped path becomes a counter-trace for return.
Later context rekeys the focus's terms through forgetting under accountability and between-space under parting.
The final dual-reaching scene reverses the focus from concealed loss to protected recovery.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah works as a compact hinge: conjunction and interval, shared neglect and autonomous agency, hidden passage and retrievable sign coexist, and later context repeatedly reverses those relations without collapsing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether سَرَبًا should privilege the tunnel image over the seepage image.
Whether the echoes in 18:73, 18:78, and 18:82 are deliberate structural activators or locally ordinary repetitions.
How far the dual نَسِيَا distributes cognition, as opposed to responsibility for the pair's shared task.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Physical arrival occurs before epistemic recognition.** `ب ل غ` B001 (“reaching the limit”) is completed, but forgetting prevents the travelers from knowing the destination as reached. The sleepers similarly inhabit elapsed centuries while estimating a day (18:19), and the garden owner inhabits a test while reading permanence (18:35). I infer that arrival does not cause recognition without attention to the relevant sign. The fish’s path marks a destination already passed cognitively.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:63–65 confirmed that recognition required mention, retracing, and renewed finding after physical arrival.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A fluid route that becomes a burrow-like trace.** `س ر ب/B003` is liquid flowing, seeping, or sinking; `س ر ب/B002` is a descending passage or burrow. The fish’s sea-course combines both, and 18:63 marks it as wondrous before 18:64 retraces the travelers’ own footprints. I infer that a path through undifferentiated water becomes legible by behaving like a cut channel. `سَرَبًا` reads as flow acquiring trace-structure, enabling a forgotten event to become navigation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:63 named the route wondrous and 18:64 made it navigational, confirming that the fluid passage had preserved enough trace to reverse travel.

branches.branch_image_ar: استجماع القوة أو السير حتى تتلاحق أجزاؤه

branches.branch_image_ar: ممالأة واجتماع مع غيرك على أمر

root_profile.summary: Kökün ana ekseni ayrı öğeleri bir araya getirme ve bu birleşmenin oluşturduğu topluluk ya da bütünlüktür. Buradan kesinleşme, toplanma yeri ve günü, avuç, cinsel birleşme, gebelik durumu, kelepçe, tamlık, güç toplama, hurma ağacı, büyük kazan ve ortak davranma gibi birbirinden ayrılmış anlam dalları gelişir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ayrılma, kopma ve birbirinden uzak düşme çevresinde kurar. Geçici çerçeve bunu sadık biçimde karşılar; sözlü açıklık veya yer aralığı anlamları bu dalın çekirdeğine taşınmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım herhangi bir özel kalıptan alınan boşluk, zaman veya söz açıklığı anlamını ithal etmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da tarafların önceki bağlantı, birliktelik veya yakınlıktan ayrılması, kopması ve birbirinden uzak düşmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam ayrılma, kopma ve tarafların birbirinden ayrı hale gelmesidir.
Ayrılık taraflar arasında uzaklaşma veya karşılıklı ayrışma biçiminde de anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda ayrılma ve kopma çekirdeğinde birleşir; bazı anlatımlar kesme yönünü, bazıları ise ayrışma ve uzaklaşma yönünü öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlik, temas veya yakınlık sonrasında gerçekleşen ayrılma çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrılma, kopma ve bağdan çıkma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarafların karşılıklı ayrıştığı sosyal, mekansal veya soyut bağlamlarda doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı ayrılma ve uzak düşme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal uzaklık, gurbet ve mesafe durumunu ayrılma işlemi olmadan da taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayrılma sonucunda mesafe ve uzaklık doğabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda ana çekirdek bağdan ayrılmadır; komşuda ana çekirdek yakın olmama ve uzak yerde bulunmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tarafların ayrılıp kopmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taraflar arasındaki orta, aralık veya ara konumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da taraflar arasındaki ilişkiyi konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkiyi koparan ayrışmayı verir; komşu dal taraflar arasındaki konum veya mesafeyi verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yayımlananlar ayrılma, uzaklık ve ara konumla en kolay karışabilecek sınırlardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: البين الفراق (maqayis;sihah)؛ البينونة مصدر بأن يبين بينا وبينونة أي قطع (ayn)؛ البين مصدر بان يبين بينا (jamhara)؛ بان كذا أي انفصل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık ve iç bölge fikrini verir. Geçici çerçeve, eldeki kalıpları da ayrı kullanım olarak sakladığı sürece bu dalı doğru temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; yalın ara-konum çekirdeği ile belirli kalıplardaki yakınlık ve içinden olma kullanımları ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık, mesafe ya da iç konumdur; bazı kalıplarda birine yakın veya bir topluluğun içinden olma anlamına bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki veya daha çok taraf arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konumdur.
Belirli kalıplarda birinin önünde, yanında veya yakınında bulunma anlamı doğar.
Bir topluluğun içinden veya o topluluğa dahil bir unsur olarak seçilmeyi anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar orta ve aralık çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca kullanımın iki veya daha çok tarafı gerektirdiği ve bazı kalıplarda yakınlık ya da içinden olma verdiği anlaşılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taraflar arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konum çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Orta konum, aralık ve taraflar arası ilişkiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki veya daha çok şeyin ortasında, aralığında ya da içinde konum bildiren akıcı metinlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arası konumu ve aralık fikrini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluk içinden seçilme veya o topluluğa dahil olma kalıbında uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aradaki konumu veya mesafeyi kurar; komşu dal bu mesafenin azalması ya da yokluğu olan yakınlığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılma ve kopma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de taraflar arasındaki ilişkiyi düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tarafların arasında ne bulunduğunu söyler; komşu dal tarafların bağdan ayrılmasını söyler.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بين الظرفية والاسمية: الوسط والخلال والمسافة بين اثنين فصاعدا، وما بين الأيدي بمعنى المتقدم أو القريب، ومن بين القوم بمعنى من جملتهم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بين بمعنى وسط (sihah)؛ بين موضوع للخلالة بين الشيئين ووسطهما (mufradat)؛ لا يستعمل بين إلا فيما كان له مسافة أو له عدد ما اثنان فصاعدا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ayrılığın zıddı olan bağ, ilişki ve insanlar arasında toparlayıcı durumlar alanını açıkça verir. Geçici çerçeve bu ilişki kurucu çekirdeği doğru taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; yalın bağ anlamı ile insanlar arasındaki durumları anlatan özel kalıp ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Taraflar arasında kopmayı değil, onları birleştiren bağ, ilişki, yakınlık veya dostluk durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam taraflar arasında bulunan bağ ve bağlantıdır.
İnsanlar arasında yakınlık, akrabalık ve sevgiyle toplu durumu anlatan kalıp kullanımı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda bağ ve bağlantı çekirdeğini verir; özel kullanımda insanlar arasındaki akrabalık, yakınlık ve sevgi durumları bu bağın görünümü olarak açıklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanlar arasındaki ilişkinin düzelmesi veya korunması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağın kendisini verir; komşu dal bozulan ilişkinin onarılması eylemini verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal birleştirici ilişkiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılıp kopmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı taraflar arası bağ ekseninin karşı yönlerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağın sürmesini veya varlığını gösterir; komşu dal bağın kopmasını gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البين بمعنى الوصل، وذات البين التي تجمع الناس من قرابة أو وصلة أو مودة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البين الوصل (ayn;sihah)؛ لقد تقطع بينكم أي وصلكم (mufradat)؛ ذات بينكم أي الأحوال التي تجمعكم من القرابة والوصلة والمودة (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.

branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.

branches.branch_image_ar: الوقت الواقع أثناء حال أو فعل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
يدخل فيه بين بين: ما كان بين الجيد والرديء، أو الهمزة المخففة بين الهمزة وحرف اللين، أو الضعيف غير المعتد به في الشاهد.
يدخل فيه تطليقة بائنة، أي طلاق فاعلة فيه بمعنى مفعولة يدل على انقطاع الرجعة.
يدخل فيه غراب البين بوصفه الغراب الذي يتشاءم به للفراق في الخبر اللغوي.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, önceden hatırda bulunan bir şeyin unutulmasını temel alır; ancak emanet edilen bilgiyi gönül zayıflığı, dalgınlık veya bilinçli bir tutum yüzünden akılda tutmamayı da aynı alan içinde sayar. Bu yüzden dalgınlığa dayalı çerçeve kullanılabilir, fakat bilinçli olarak akılda tutmayı bırakma olasılığı dışarıda bırakılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım temel unutma sürecini verir; çok unutkan kişi, unutturma ve unutmuş görünme gibi biçim ya da söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşimleridir.

concept_map.definition: Daha önce hatırda bulunan bir şeyin zihinden çıkması veya insana koruması için verilen bilginin artık akılda tutulmamasıdır. Bu durum gönül zayıflığından, dalgınlıktan ya da bilinçli bir tutumdan doğabilir ve kişide sık yinelenen bir özellik olabilir.

facets.statement: Daha önce hatırda bulunan şey zihinde hazır olmaktan çıkar ve kişi onu anamaz.
Korunması için verilen bilgiyi akılda tutmama, gönül zayıflığına, dalgınlığa veya bilinçli bir tutuma bağlanabilir.
Unutma sık yinelendiğinde kişinin yerleşik bir özelliği olarak anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, hatırlamanın ve akılda tutmanın karşıtı olan unutmadır. Derlenmiş açıklama, daha önce zihinde bulunan şeyin kaybolmasını, korunması istenen bilginin tutulmamasını ve sık unutma özelliğini birlikte gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النَّسْي والنِّسْي لما ينسى أو يطرح أو لا يؤبه له، ورذال أمتعة المرتحلين، وخرق الحيض الملقاة، وكل حقير جار مجرى المنسي.
يدخل فيه النَّسَا اسما للعرق الممتد من الورك أو منشق الفخذ، وتثنيته نسيان وجمعه أنساء، والاشتكاء منه أو إصابته.
يدخل فيه معنى أنسأ ونسأ إذا أخر، وتأخر الحيض، وبيع النسيئة، وإطالة الأجل، وتأخر القوم وتباعدهم، وتأخير حرمة الشهر، وزيادة ظمء الإبل، وما جعلته المصادر من نبت الوبر بعد سقوطه لتأخره.
يدخل فيه المنسأة اسما للعصا، وفعل نسأ الناقة بمعنى ضربها بالمنسأة ودفعها أو إبعادها بها.
يدخل فيه النَّسِي أو النَّسء أو النَّسِيء اسما للحليب الذي يصب عليه الماء، وما وصف بأنه ينسى العقل في هذا النقل.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أخذ الأسير، والأخيذ، ومعنى وخذوهم أي ائسروهم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأخيذ الأسير والمرأة أخيذة (sihah)؛ ومن هنا قيل للأسير أخيذ وقد أخذ فلان إذا أسر وخذوهم معناه ائسروهم (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأخذة رقية تأخذ العين، والتأخيذ والسحر أو الخرزة التي تحبس الرجل أو المرأة عن النكاح أو الرأي.
يدخل فيه الإخاذة بمعنى الضيعة أو الأرض التي يأخذها الإنسان أو السلطان لنفسه ويحوزها ويحييها.
يدخل فيه الإخاذ والإخاذة والإخذ: مجتمع ماء أو حوض أو حفرة تمسك الماء أياما، وما يشبه الغدير.
يدخل فيه أخذ المرض أو الرمد، والمستأخذ المستكين لمرضه، وأخذ البعير أو الشاة كهيئة الجنون، وتخمة الفصيل، وأخذ السمن في الإبل.
يدخل فيه نجوم الأخذ، وهي منازل القمر، وتسميتها لأن القمر يأخذ كل ليلة في منزل أو نوء.
يدخل فيه أخذ إخذ القوم أو أخذهم، أي السير بسيرتهم أو أخذ شكلهم وخلائقهم وهديهم.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin yol ve ulaşma aracı anlamları ile dinsel yön bildiren söz öbeği ayrı tutulmuştur.

concept_map.definition: Üzerinde gidilen, uzanmış yol; ayrıca bir amaca erişmeyi sağlayan bağlantı, yöntem veya çıkış yoludur. Dinsel doğruluk ve iyiliğe yönelten yol anlamı yalnız ilgili söz öbeğinde belirginleşir.

Belirli dinsel söz öbeklerinde doğruluğa, iyiliğe veya kurtuluşa yönelten yolu belirtir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السبيل بمعنى الطريق والطرق، وما يتوصل به إلى شيء من سبب ووصلة وحيلة ومحجة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: السبيل وهو الطريق سمي بذلك لامتداده (maqayis)؛ والسبيل يذكر ويؤنث وجمعه سبل (ayn)؛ السبيل معروف تذكر وتؤنث والجمع سبل وهي الطرق (jamhara)؛ السبيل الطريق؛ أي سببا ووصلة (sihah)؛ السبيل الطريق؛ لا يستطيعون في أمرك حيلة (tahdhib)؛ السبيل الطريق الذي فيه سهولة؛ لكل ما يتوصل به إلى شيء (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السابلة والسابلون وابن السبيل، أي المسافر أو من يختلف في الطرقات للحاجة.
يدخل فيه سبل المال أو الضيعة أي وقفها أو جعلها في سبيل الله، وما يسلك في سبل الخير ومصرف سبيل الله.
يدخل فيه أسبل الستر والسحابة والمطر والدمع، وأسبل إزاره وثيابه وذيله وذنب الفرس، أي أرسلها وأرخاها إلى أسفل.
يدخل فيه السبل والسبلة بمعنى المطر، ولا سيما المطر المسبل أو الجاري بين السحاب والأرض قبل وصوله.
يدخل فيه السبلة والسبال: شعر الشفة العليا، وما يجمع الشاربين وما بينهما، ومقدم اللحية أو ما أسبل منها على الصدر.
يدخل فيه أسبال الدلو وسبلة الإناء بمعنى الشفة أو الرأس، وسبلة البعير أو الناقة بمعنى المنحر أو ثغرة النحر وما جاورها.
يدخل فيه السنبل والسنبلة والسبولة، وخروج سنبل الزرع أو صيرورته ذا سنبلة.
يدخل فيه المسبل اسما لقدح من قداح الميسر، مع اختلاف المصادر في ترتيبه الخامس أو السادس.
يدخل فيه السبل داء في العين كغشاوة أو نسج العنكبوت بعروق حمر.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سرب القربة أو المزادة بالماء حتى تنتفخ عيون الخرز وتنسد وتتبع عيوبها لتكتم الماء
يدخل فيه السرب والسربة من الظباء والقطا والنساء والخيل والحمر والشاء والإبل والمال الراعي وإرسال الإبل أو الخيل قطعة قطعة والجماعة التي تغير وترجع
يدخل فيه آمن في سربه بمعنى نفسه أو قلبه أو أهله وواسع السرب بمعنى رخي البال واسع الصدر بطيء الغضب
يدخل فيه قول الجاهلية للمرأة اذهبي فلا أنده سربك كناية عن الطلاق وترك رد إبلها أو سربها حيث شاءت
يدخل فيه المسربة شعر وسط الصدر إلى السرة أو العانة ومنساح السرب ومسارب الدواب في مراقها وأرفاغها وآباطها ومسربة الحلقة ومسارب الحيات آثارها
يدخل فيه السراب والآل وما يلوح في المفازة أو نصف النهار كأنه ماء وما يجري في مرأى العين بلا حقيقة ماء
